content:
**Pain Train** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased damage and chance to Stagger enemies by sprinting into them with Power Armor. It deals 15/30/50 damage that is resisted by Damage Resistance.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Devastate and stagger enemies by sprinting into them with Power Armor. | 00065E3D | 
| ★★ | 2 | Smash and stagger enemies by sprinting into them with Power Armor. | 00065E3C | 
| ★ | 1 | Damage and stagger enemies by sprinting into them with Power Armor. | 0004D89B |
